aiDescription: Adds a curated collection of music tracks from multiple mods and creators, including Blackrock, Exigency, Mayorate, Tiandong, Star Federation, and Shadowyards. The music is organized to differentiate between core worlds, non-core space, and hyperspace, with improved volume balance and track variety. Sound effects from Cycerin are also included.
